2. End-to-End Enterprise Agent Business Continuity, AGENTS.md Governance & 6-Step Audit Architecture
Four-Pillar Governance: Lockout Backup Kit ➔ Standardized AGENTS.md ➔ 6-Step Cross-Model ICode ➔ Yumi Notch Companion
Pillar A: Agent Lockout Continuity (MuseAi-Account-Backup)
• Core Continuity Invariant: Business owners retain independent
recovery access if an autonomous AI agent is locked out
• Metadata-Only Offline Worksheet: Static HTML/JSON inventory
records rotation schedules & vault pointers (never raw secrets)
• Operational Checklists: Onboarding, offboarding, credential
rotation & secret-exposure incident response SOPs
• License: Permissive MIT License (★120 stars)
✓ Prevents single-agent lockout from halting business ops
Pillar B: `AGENTS.md` Standardizer (agent-rules-skill)
• Machine-First Context Specification: Generates `AGENTS.md`
optimized specifically for AI coding agents (60,000+ repos)
• Empirical Best Practices: Encodes structural lessons from
GitHub's analysis of 2,500+ production `AGENTS.md` files
• Cross-Harness Compatibility: Consumed natively by GitHub
Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor & Windsurf
• License: CC-BY-SA-4.0 (SPDX header declared)
✓ Eliminates ad-hoc, unmaintained repo instruction files
Pillar C: 6-Step Multi-Model Workflow (ayukyo/icode-skill)
• Deterministic 6-Stage Pipeline (`v2.41.0`):
Plan -> Review -> Finalize -> Code -> Deep Check -> Audit
• Independent Cross-Model Review: Switch models between steps
so one model never grades its own plan or implementation
• Ticket-Based Resumable State: Supports Claude Code, Codex,
CodeBuddy & WorkBuddy with evidence-based verification
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Enforces independent cross-model design & code auditing
Pillar D: Ask-Before-Act Notch AI (estebanbaigts/Yumi)
• Three-Step Safety Contract: (1) Shows exact diff/change
beforehand, (2) Waits for user click, (3) Verifies state after
• Native macOS 15+ Notch UI: Zero-clutter Swift interface
for reminders, calendar events, notes & custom tricks
• Privacy-First Desktop Execution: Requires no cloud account
and emits zero telemetry
• License: Permissive MIT License
✓ Eliminates silent calendar/reminder corruption by personal AI
3. Closed-Form FinOps TCO Verification (CLAIM-20261120-R39-R598-MUSEAIBACKUP-AGENTRULES-ICODESKILL-YUMI · 43 Eng @ $100/h)
Path A: Ad-Hoc Agent Secrets + Manual AGENTS.md + Single-LLM
• SaaS Subscriptions & Lockout Incident Costs: $3,160.00 / mo
• Manual Rules, Audit & Recovery: 39.5 h × $100 = $3,950.00 / mo
• Overhead: Stranded credentials when an agent breaks, stale
repo instructions & unverified single-model self-grading
Path C: Hybrid OSS (BackupKit + AgentRules + ICode + Yumi)
• Cross-Model Audit API & Static Hosting: $70.00 / mo
• Continuity & 6-Step Gate Review: 2.4 h × $100 = $240.00 / mo
• Outcome: Metadata-only lockout recovery, 60k-standard
`AGENTS.md`, 6-step cross-model ICode & pre-verified Yumi
